# SEC-004: No stray backup files in the proxy dynamic config folder

- **Group:** Secrets on disk
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check reports `unknown`, never a pass.

## Why it matters

Traefik's file provider loads every .yml, .yaml and .toml file in its dynamic folder. A copy such as app.backup.yml is loaded as live config: old routers come back, duplicate names conflict, and a router removed on purpose is served again. Editor leftovers also show what was there before.

## Verify by hand

```sh
ls -la /data/coolify/proxy/dynamic /etc/dokploy/traefik/dynamic
```

## How to fix it

Move backup and editor files out of the dynamic folder (for example into a sibling backups folder).

Run `stackward explain SEC-004` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
